input.task: Write a debounce function in TypeScript.

mock_nodes.coding: export function debounce(fn: () => void, ms = 200) { let timer: number | undefined; return () => { if (timer) clearTimeout(timer); timer = setTimeout(fn, ms); }; }
mock_nodes.story: Once upon a time a function waited.
